verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an agent that can run scheduled deliverability reports and report on message performance, which glancingly covers deliverability monitoring and guidance. Nothing in the evidence shows per-send bounce, complaint, or blocklist signals, or alerting when deliverability degrades. Missing for 10: per-send bounce/complaint metrics, blocklist monitoring, degradation alerts with actionable guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
